title: Building a transparent always-on-top desktop pet game with AI-assisted dev — early Steam WIP demo
author: revyxrevyx
selftext:
Been working on Desktop Peers — a desktop pet game where your pets sit on top of your real desktop, not in a window you have to alt-tab to.

The window is transparent and always on top, so it feels more like a toy on your screen than a traditional game. You drag pets around, feed them, equip items, open a little phone UI for inventory/shop, jump into combat when you want, or hop into rooms with other players.

Demo (current state): [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ui27fMwV6Ag](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ui27fMwV6Ag)

Still early and messy in places, but this is where it’s at right now.

AI writes most of the code on my end, but the prompts are specific — bug fixes, refactors, one feature at a time. Not vibe-coding the whole thing in one shot.

Feedback welcome
